props.question: Tell me about the last clinical decision you made with nobody available to check it.
props.competency_label: Working autonomously on a rural caseload

props.nudge: They are listening for how you decided, not for how the visit turned out. What did you weigh up, and what would have changed your mind?
structure: What you noticed that made this a decision
What you weighed, and what you ruled out
How you knew afterwards it was the right call

props.worked: You named the clinical signs that made you escalate, in the order you noticed them. That is the part a panel can follow.
props.improve: The outcome arrived in your last sentence. Lead with it, then explain how you got there.

covered: Working autonomously on a rural caseload
props.note: You have answered on lone working three times now, and the last one held up under a follow-up question.

props.intro: Your interview is tomorrow. This is a short run through what you already have, not new practice.
focus: The escalation story, out loud, in under three minutes
Your wound assessment sequence, from first look to review
One sentence on why community nursing rather than ward work
